name: week
title: Query performance review
subtitle: Saved evidence, tuning owners and follow-up. Fictional demo when seeded.

sections.title: Latest observed performance
sections.sql: SELECT host,query_name,owner,mean_ms,observed_seconds,missing_points FROM latest_queries ORDER BY mean_ms DESC NULLS LAST
sections.note: Mean latency is withheld when any paired sample is missing. Each row uses its own latest window.

sections.title: Changes between comparable windows
sections.sql: SELECT r.host,r.query_name,r.previous_ms,r.mean_ms,r.change_pct FROM regressions r JOIN latest_queries l ON l.query_id=r.query_id AND l.window_end=r.window_end ORDER BY change_pct DESC NULLS LAST
sections.note: Only equal-length windows produce a percentage. A change is evidence to investigate, not proof of cause.

sections.title: Open tuning work
sections.sql: SELECT host,query_name,title,owner,due,overdue FROM action_queue WHERE status='open' ORDER BY due

sections.title: Record controls
sections.sql: SELECT rule,record,owner,finding FROM compliance_findings ORDER BY rule,record
